_about: Character voices for Pet Agents (English only). Each character's voice is cloned on your Mac by F5-TTS (MLX) from a few seconds of their real English speech (dubs and films) in Sounds/ (fetch with tools/sounds/fetch_sounds.py). No per-character model is downloaded. Install with tools/voice/install_voice.sh <character>.
